items.story: In a notable development, UBS Group AG has secured a 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM by exercising warrants. This action comes over a year after UBS shifted its local wealth management operations to the company. The Swiss bank has now executed over 20.5 million warrants and fulfilled the payment obligation that began with a 25% down payment, marking a substantial investment in India.

items.headline: Nippon AMC gets Sebi nod for settlement in Yes Bank AT1 case
items.teaser: Nippon Life India Asset Management Company has obtained in-principle approval from Sebi regarding a settlement case involving mutual fund…
items.story: Nippon Life India Asset Management Company has obtained in-principle approval from Sebi regarding a settlement case involving mutual fund investments in Yes Bank's AT1 bonds. With a settlement payment of ₹96.8 crore, including management fee reversals, this comes after a show-cause notice was issued in August 2024 due to alleged non-compliance. The final ruling from Sebi is still anticipated by the company and its representatives.

items.headline: Yes Bank AT1 coupon due, bondholders seek clarity
items.teaser: YES Bank's bondholders have not received recent coupon payments which were due shortly after a court ruling. The Supreme Court restored t…
items.story: YES Bank's bondholders have not received recent coupon payments which were due shortly after a court ruling. The Supreme Court restored the value of these bonds, raising uncertainty among investors. Bondholders have requested that the trustee clarify the status of unpaid coupons. Another coupon payment is also approaching, adding to the urgency of the situation. Bondholders expect payments to proceed in accordance with the court's ruling and official guidelines.

items.headline: El Niño then and now
items.teaser: El Niño is part of a natural climate pattern that occurs roughly every two to seven years, bringing warmer-than-normal water to parts of …
items.story: El Niño is part of a natural climate pattern that occurs roughly every two to seven years, bringing warmer-than-normal water to parts of the equatorial Pacific. The most recent very strong El Niño events, in 1997–98 and 2015–16, upended weather patterns. Impacts spanned the planet, from fires in Indonesia and the Amazon to crop failures due to drought in southern Africa to heavy rain and coastal flooding in Southern California. The current El Niño rivals these past heavyweights.

items.story: Human cells hold about two meters (6.6 feet) of DNA, folded and compacted to fit inside a nucleus. That packing is essential for life, but it creates a problem for scientists. Samayam Teluguఏదేమైనా మహారాష్ట్రను ఒప్పించి తీరాలి: అధికారులకు సీఎం రేవంత్ కీలక ఆదేశాలు Disha dailyత్వరలో మహారాష్ట్ర ప్రభుత్వంతో చర్చలు: రేవంత్‌రెడ్డి | Eenaduతుమ్మిడిహెట్టి బ్యారేజ్‌పై త్వరలోనే మహారాష్ట్రతో చర్చలు : రేవంత్ రెడ్డి Telugu Times

items.story: రాహుల్ గాంధీపై బీజేపీ విమర్శలు.. శశీ థరూర్ కౌంటర్ AndhrajyothyPM Modi: కాంగ్రెస్‌ పార్టీ విఫల సరకు రాహుల్‌ Eenaduఒకే 'ఫెయిల్డ్ ప్రొడక్ట్'ను పదేపదే లాంచ్ చేస్తున్నారు: కాంగ్రెస్‌పై ప్రధాని మోదీ తీవ్ర విమర్శలు AP7AM‘దేశ ప్రతిష్టను తాకట్టు పెడుతున్నారు’.. రాహుల్‌పై విరుచుకుపడ్డ ప్రధాని మోదీ! BigTvLivePM Modi: ‘దేశాన్ని పణంగా పెట్టి విఫల ఉత్పత్తిని ప్రమోట్ చేస్తారా?’.. కాంగ్రెస్‌పై ప్రధాని మోడీ తీవ్ర విమర్శలు NTV Telugu
